info.title: CSK Hub API
info.description: Authentication endpoints under /api/auth belong to Better Auth and are used through its client.

impersonatedBy.description: The impersonating Admin's User ID, or null for the User's own session.

code.description: Stable error code. Clients must tolerate unknown codes.

manageOrganisation.description: May manage Groups, Memberships and Positions.

administerEvents.description: May administer all Events and Locations.

permissions.description: UI hints for the current User, computed per request. Operations re-check authority.

query.description: The trimmed search that was applied.

page.description: The page served, clamped to the last page.

code.description: Zod issue code or a validation message ID.

message.description: Whether the caller may message this member.

permissions.description: UI hints for the current User; every operation re-checks authority.

messageConversationId.description: The existing Direct Conversation with this member, if any.

email.description: Only the profile's owner sees an email.

capabilities.description: Self-reported voices the member can sing.

otherGroups.description: Active Groups of an archived Choir, shown with their Choir's name.

RichTextDocument.description: The editor's document (ProseMirror JSON), restricted to what a Post body may contain.

authorName.description: Null once the author has been erased.

editedAt.description: When the title or body last changed after publishing.

authorName.description: Null once the author has been erased.

editedAt.description: When the title or body last changed after publishing.

count.description: Published Posts from the last 30 days the User has not opened.

nextChangeAt.description: When the count next changes without a write: a publication or a 30-day expiry.

otherMemberName.description: The other member, or the Group Conversation's name; null after Erasure.

canSend.description: False after departure or when the other member is inactive.

otherMemberProfileId.description: Direct only: the active member's id.

readToken.description: Proves the caller saw `newestSequence`; required to mark it read.

code.description: Stable Messaging failure code. Clients must tolerate unknown codes.

EventDescription.description: The editor's document (ProseMirror JSON) for an Event description.

code.description: Stable Events failure code: a rule the Event or Location broke. Tolerate unknown codes.

description.description: The description document as a JSON string.

canVerify.description: A UI hint only; verification re-checks authority.

image.description: The User's photo URL, or null when none is set.

choirs.description: Current Choir affiliations, excluding archived Groups. May be empty.

code.description: Stable error code. Clients must tolerate unknown codes.

token.description: The opaque QR value. Never put it in a URL, log or storage.

rotateAfterMs.description: Fetch the next code after this many milliseconds.

verifiedAt.description: Unix milliseconds. A snapshot, not a lasting grant.
